title: Linear Programming Bounds for Fibered Sphere Packings
summary: We study linear programming (LP) bounds for sphere packings that fiber over translates of a fixed lattice of lower rank, as well as their dual formulations. In doing so, we place the work of Conway and Sloane on fibered packings in the context of linear programming bounds for packing problems on $\mathbb{R}^k \times A$, where $A$ is a compact abelian group. For these programs we prove that the primal and the dual both attain their optima, so that every instance has an optimal pair satisfying complementary slackness.
